# Stranded SecLists and Laudanum members

All 26 listed members are MALICIOUS payloads when judged individually. The two outer archives retain their supplied confirmed MALICIOUS verdicts. No archive verdict was inferred for a member. Source inspection, ZIP local/central-header inspection, bounded DEFLATE decoding, `cleave facts` (including decoded text, calls and flow), and before/after `atomscan` runs supplied the evidence below. No payload was launched.

Confirmed outer archives: `danielmiessler-SecLists-2025.3-source.tar.gz` (`8fa88740c36777012f637ebb844de43d1020fb4273e080019d5f0c80360f433f`) and `laudanum_1.0+r36-0kali6_all.deb` (`c3f630db99ff2233200805aca89a8d37fc91aa46953e3667e85fbff148099ebf`). Their confirmation was supplied by the queue and is retained.

The Debian extractor initially materialized `usr/share/laudanum/...`. Byte-identical copies of the seven requested members were placed under the queue’s `data/usr/share/laudanum/...` paths, verified against the listed hashes, analyzed there, and marked there. The included WordPress IP filter was also read from the original extraction.

The facts extractor’s Base64 candidates decode GPL warranty wording (the word `MERCHANTABILITY`) into nonsensical bytes; the source never evaluates those candidates. No intentional encoded executable payload was found. `hidden.php` instead conceals its operation through request-variable import and variable-function invocation.

Paths in the table are relative to the named extraction root. Each row identifies the exact bytes and the concrete source/format behavior. The malformed Debian PHP shell is retained as a malicious source payload, with its syntax limitation recorded explicitly.

Thirteen observations were relocated with their matchers, effective type/platform scopes, criticality and exclusions preserved: five archive member-table observations into `metadata/file/archive`, two UI controls into `micro-behaviors/ui/controls`, reverse-shell terminology into `metadata/lang/natural`, tiny-RAR signature/size observations into `metadata/file/size`, PE overlay TOC evidence into `metadata/binary/section/layout`, and two NuGet layout exceptions into `metadata/package/files/nuget`. The duplicate ROCm experiment exception was replaced with the existing Ollama ROCm layout exception; its required member traits already constrain it to the same ZIP layout.

The archive leaf remains below its 100-rule budget. Its broad traversal-count matcher lives in the already-admitted `archive.yaml`; the validator rejects the same broad format list in a new filename. No format coverage was removed to evade that restriction. Unchanged source-file siblings remain in place. `moves.json` records all original effective definitions and the exact ID mapping. Live references and affected fixture expectations were updated; ancestor selectors were audited. The moved Ollama exception remains excluded from positive directory selectors.

Two general detections cover previously omitted reads: parser-projected PHP `fgets` calls and Classic ASP/VBScript child `StdOut`/`StdErr` `ReadAll`/`ReadLine` syntax. Both are notable capabilities. Comment/string-only PHP mentions and unrelated/commented ASP reads are negative controls.

Validation evidence: all 26 member rescans retain every pre-existing finding after ID mapping; each has at least two hostile traits (the WARs have three, including a third-party rule). Only the two new notable stream-read observations were added. Twelve positive and near-miss controls pass in neutral paths, including traversal/contained ZIPs, password/command controls, terminology and stream reads. The source snapshots confirm unchanged effective matching for the thirteen moves.

Run the focused controls with `python3 testdata/taxonomy/stranded-source-members/check.py --scratch-root <scratch-directory>`. The benign fixed-`nslookup` ASP fixture also reads child stdout, so its expected score range increases by one and the new notable trait is required. Its zero-hostile, zero-suspicious and forbidden-webshell constraints are unchanged. The final repository gate is `make validate`.
